description: Twelve saturated consolidated-undrained triaxial histories from Mont Terri shaly Opalinus Clay, distinct from the Nordas candidate-sites specimens. Preparation and strain rates follow Sections 3.1, 3.4 and Table 3 of the paper.
retrieval_status: All twelve original files downloaded and parsed on 2026-10-06. Original bytes are retained in raw/.
units: The raw strain columns are percent; the loader converts to dimensionless strain. Stress and pressure are MPa, time is hours, compression is positive.
orientation: Figure 2 and Section 3.3 use source_angle_deg=0 for S (normal loading) and 90 for P (parallel loading). The model uses the complementary plane-to-loading-axis angle: theta=90-source_angle_deg. Z labels carry the source angle.
pressure_reference: Raw mean u is absolute pore pressure. The loader uses u-u[0] for the observed increment, and reconstructs total cell pressure as p_eff-q/3+u. Initial effective confinement is the median reconstructed cell pressure minus u[0]; nominal consolidation pressure is also retained.
radial_measurement: Only one radial direction was measured. Section 5.2 explicitly rules out calculating total volume strain from it. The radial channel is retained separately and is not converted to axial+2*radial volume.
split_design: Assigned before neural fitting: seven complete training specimens cover the two symmetry orientations, source angles 30, 37 and 60 degrees and all preparation pressures. Five test specimens hold out source angles 15, 25, 45 and 75 degrees; both 75-degree specimens are withheld. All adjustable material and neural parameters must be learned from the training specimens. This is an orientation prediction test within the Mont Terri population, not transfer of the Nordas material parameters.
record_treatment: Acquisition order and repeated or decreasing recorded axial strains are preserved. No smoothing or resampling is performed by the loader. loading_stop is an exclusive zero-based numeric-row boundary after the header and blank lines are removed. Original terminal records remain in raw/.
source_discrepancies: OPA10 (Z30) raw u[0]=3.49 MPa and reconstructed cell pressure=13.50 MPa, while Table 3 lists 2.0 and 12.0 MPa. OPA18 (Z25) raw values are 2.00 and 12.00 MPa, while the table lists 3.5 and 13.5 MPa. The raw pairs are used without exchanging specimen identities; both give approximately 10 MPa effective preparation pressure.

The Table 3 column labelled maximum excess pressure numerically tracks absolute raw maxima, for example 8.68 MPa for OPA10, whereas its raw pressure increment is 5.19 MPa. Excess pressures are recomputed from the raw initial values.
OPA15 (Z75 at 10 MPa) reaches q=16.05 MPa at recorded axial strain 0.54 percent; Table 3 lists 0.64. The raw strain is retained. Its local strain reversals are preserved rather than sorted away.

OPA24's final unloading and depressurization is separated from the loading segment. OPA10's isolated final pressure collapse is excluded from the loading segment because it occurs at unchanged recorded strain; its experimental cause is not established by the file. Neither exclusion depends on model predictions.
